simulate_reward_slate: simulate reward for a slate of documents using a positional cascade model with tap and abandon
create_random_document: create a random Document namedtuple with tap, quality, and abandon attributes from a PRNG
run_toyvmenv_step: run a step in the ToyVMEnv gym environment with an action selecting documents from candidates
reset_toyvmenv: reset the ToyVMEnv gym environment to sample new candidate documents and return initial observation
make_toyvm_wrapper: make a ToyVM EnvWrapper with TimeLimit and ValueWrapper for recommendation simulation with configurable slate size
